## Testing Mode
UPDATE

## Story DD Coverage
DD4: dispatch.py uses asyncio.gather(return_exceptions=True) with partial-failure producing error entry per failed specialist

## Context
The existing dispatch_review() in dispatch.py handles single-call fallback chains (story 298a).
This task adds a NEW function for parallel multi-specialist dispatch (story e596).
Do NOT modify dispatch_review() — add the new function alongside it.

## Implementation
Add to plugins/dso/scripts/dso_ci_review/dispatch.py:

```python
import asyncio

async def _dispatch_single_agent(agent_id: str, diff_text: str, model: str) -> dict:
    """Call one reviewer agent. Returns findings dict or error entry on failure."""
    try:
        result = dispatch_review(diff_text=diff_text, agent_id=agent_id, primary_model=model, provider_chain=["anthropic"])
        return result
    except Exception as exc:
        return {
            "findings": [{
                "type": "specialist_error",
                "agent_id": agent_id,
                "severity": "important",
                "description": f"Specialist {agent_id} failed: {type(exc).__name__}: {exc}",
                "cited_lines": [],
            }]
        }

async def async_dispatch_specialists(
    agents: list[dict],  # [{"agent_id": str, "model": str, "diff_text": str}]
) -> list[dict]:
    """Dispatch all specialists concurrently. Returns list of findings dicts (never raises)."""
    tasks = [_dispatch_single_agent(a["agent_id"], a["diff_text"], a["model"]) for a in agents]
    results = await asyncio.gather(*tasks, return_exceptions=True)
    findings = []
    for i, result in enumerate(results):
        if isinstance(result, Exception):
            findings.append({"findings": [{"type": "specialist_error", "agent_id": agents[i]["agent_id"], "severity": "important", "description": str(result), "cited_lines": []}]})
        else:
            findings.append(result)
    return findings
```

## Test Update Required
Update tests/skills/dso_ci_review/test_dispatch_fallback.py to add:
- test_async_dispatch_partial_failure: inject exception on one specialist → other results preserved + error entry
- test_async_dispatch_all_succeed: all specialists return findings → combined result correct

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Lint passes
  Verify: ruff check plugins/dso/scripts/dso_ci_review/dispatch.py
- [ ] async_dispatch_specialists importable
  Verify: PYTHONPATH=plugins/dso/scripts python3 -c "from dso_ci_review.dispatch import async_dispatch_specialists"
- [ ] asyncio.gather is used
  Verify: grep -q "asyncio.gather" plugins/dso/scripts/dso_ci_review/dispatch.py
- [ ] return_exceptions=True is passed
  Verify: grep -q "return_exceptions=True" plugins/dso/scripts/dso_ci_review/dispatch.py

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
